reference.citation: Tukey JW (1949) HSD. Reference impls: base R stats::TukeyHSD and scipy.stats.tukey_hsd. Data: vertical-GRF dynamic range (PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) across five gait classes, GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020).
reference.description: re-computes all pairwise Tukey HSD comparisons of the vertical-GRF dynamic range across the five gait classes with base R TukeyHSD and scipy.stats.tukey_hsd and confirms tukeyHSD reproduces both to machine precision; also reports the healthy-vs-pathology / pathology-pathology significance split
